title: A/P Detail: a vendor credit dated on the as-of date is Current, Past Due 0
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a vendor with an unused vendor credit, vendor credit A, dated an earlier day, date A.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with only that vendor ticked in the Vendor filter.
custom_steps:
1. Change the as-of date to date A.
  2. Expand the "Current" bucket.
  3. Change the as-of date to the day after date A.
  4. Expand the "1-30 days past due" bucket.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report reloads for date A.

Step 2:

  • Vendor credit A is listed in this bucket.
  • Its Due Date is date A, its own date.
  • Its Past Due reads 0.

Step 3:

  • The report reloads for the day after date A, with every bucket collapsed.

Step 4:

  • Vendor credit A is now listed here, with Past Due 1, and no longer in "Current".

Where the tech plan differs: the tech plan (21 Oct 2026) says credits are never Current; PRD version 11 (S1-R5a, 4 and 5 Nov 2026) puts a credit dated exactly on the as-of date in Current with Past Due 0. This case follows the PRD.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S1-R5a: “A document is Current when its due date is on or after the as-of date. Its Past Due, where the report shows one, is the number of days from the due date to the as-of date: negative while the document is not yet due (a bill due 9 days after the as-of date reads -9, as today) and 0 on its due date. A credit memo, deposit or vendor credit counts its own date as its due date, so one dated exactly on the as-of date is in Current with Past Due 0, not in "1-30 days past due". This is how QuickBooks ages them (SV-11441).”
  • S2-R6: “A blank value (for example a vendor credit on A/P Unpaid Invoices, which has no due date and no Past Due) sorts to the bottom of its group in both directions. On A/P Detail a vendor credit shows its own date as its due date, as today, so it is not blank there.”
  • S4-N1: “Changing the as-of date, the customer or vendor filter, the Past due filter or the Location filter collapses every group, as changing the date or filter does today.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §6 Phase 4, backend: “A/P vendor credit due date = its own date (S2-R6 note); credits never Current”

Not yet checked against a build: the QA build v26.45.2-6a8b89c exists since 10 Nov 2026 and this case has not been run on it yet.
